fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight into brush nor through terrain}} and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals {{as|physical damage}} to {{tt|nearby|centered on the initial target}} enemies and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can grant sight into brush and through terrain}} for 2 seconds.
fields.description2: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|10 to 100 for 16|0 to 1500}} damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
fields.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
fields.description3: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}} is capped at 1200 against {{tip|monsters}}.
fields.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
fields.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the explosion.
* ''Super Mega Death Rocket's'' projectile has an [[File:Super Mega Death Rocket! Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Jinx''' and her allies.
* The bonus damage based on missing health is based on each unit's own missing health and not the primary target's.
* Unlike similar spells, ''Super Mega Death Rocket'' will not increase it's damage when ranked up while the missile is in flight.{{bug|2}}
** This is because the base damage is fixed at a multiple of the damage the rocket initially started with.
** The {{as|'''bonus''' AD}} ratio will still update when {{as|AD}} is gained or lost between the cast and hit of the missile.
